scope: finite-memory Meir–Wingreen charge and Hermitian-observable spin currents from two-time Keldysh kernels
implementation_change: Add two_time_meir_wingreen_current with explicit finite-memory lead kernels.
Add two_time_spin_meir_wingreen_current for arbitrary Hermitian spin observables.
Connect the interacting two-time SCBA output to the current contraction.
claim_boundary: The API supports charge/spin contractions but does not yet close a full interacting lead-plus-torque continuity equation.
Spin-polarized reservoir parameterization and Kane–Mele edge-current protection remain open gates.
